item.title: WPP Media’s Sairam Ranganathan and Karthik Shankar on QCom’s rise and why brands built for speed will win 2026
item.description: Quick commerce has compressed what once took hours into a matter of minutes. item.title: Meta strikes new deals with publishers to supply real-time content for Meta AI
item.description: Meta has reached new licensing agreements with several major news publishers to supply real-time information for Meta AI, its artificial intelligence chatbot, the company announced Saturday. The partnerships will allow Meta AI to provide breaking news, entertainment updates and lifestyle stories generated from a broader set of sources. item.title: Omnicom places Ulka & Mudra within BBDO in global Restructure
item.description: Legacy Indian advertising agencies Ulka and Mudra have been moved under the BBDO Group as part of Omnicom’s global restructuring following its merger with Interpublic Group (IPG). The Omnicom–IPG merger, valued at about $9 billion, was announced earlier this year and has led to a worldwide alignment of networks, roles and resources. item.title: Havas Media Network India secures integrated media mandate for Tata 1mg
item.description: Havas Media Network India has secured the integrated media mandate for Tata 1mg following a multi-agency pitch, the companies said Monday. The mandate will be shared between PivotRoots, the network’s digital-first agency, which will handle Tata 1mg’s digital brand marketing, and Havas Media India, which will manage traditional media duties. item.description: Chat360 has announced its partnership with Meta to enable WhatsApp Business Voice Calling, empowering enterprises to deliver integrated, intelligent, and real-time voice communication. item.title: Court orders new limits on Google’s search and AI deals
item.description: Google’s U.S. antitrust case has entered a new phase, with U.S. District Judge Amit Mehta issuing expanded conditions that outline how the company must alter its business practices after being found to hold an illegal monopoly in internet search, according to a news report.
